Follow the adventures of the Pontypandy Rescue Team who are now operating from their spectacular new Fire Station and Mobile Command Unit.
Audio Descriptions available on some episodes
When filming a tourism advert about Pontypandy, Sarah gets carried away with her filming. When she climbs a mountain to get the perfect shot, she ends up stranded on a ledge.
The Way of the Wild Walkers
When Peter creates a wild and adventurous trail for Scoop Dooley to follow, they both end up getting lost.
When James tries to win the star globe in a Star Spotter competition, he ends up breaking it and falls into the water chasing it. The team launch an ocean rescue to save the day.
Hannah starts a scarecrow business, but there is one brave little bird that just isn't scared of her scarecrows.
When Joe, Peter and Mike go up the mountain without their coats, a sunny day turns bad fast, and Mike gets injured.
While on an archaeological dig, Norman and Peter get trapped on a cliff ledge while trying to find the King of Pontypandy's crown.
When Miss Pawdry stows away on a Pioneer camping trip, she leads Mandy and the rest of the Pioneers into the forest and gets them all lost.
When Peter lets Nipper off his lead after promising not to, Nipper runs away. Peter tries to get Nipper back but accidentally scares the dog off the edge of a cliff.
Competition between Norman and Derek to make the best stone age shelter goes too far and causes a fire on Pontypandy Island.
It's the opening of the New Fire Station and Norman hasn't got his Pioneer uniform ready. Dilys rushes to iron it, but the old iron she uses causes a fire.
Mandy is looking after James and Sarah's guinea pig, Norris. But when Norris escapes, in the ensuing chaos, Mandy accidentally starts a fire.
The Pioneers work on Annie's farm, but Sarah accidentally lets the sheep go loose. They knock over Annie's stove which starts a fire.
When Mike hears eerie singing and glowing lights in the sea near the lighthouse, he calls Agent Price and Agent Sparkes to check it out.
When Hannah shows off a homemade kite, her stunts cause a barbequing accident, sparking multiple fires!
When James plans a cafe makeover for the Wholefish Cafe, he becomes over-zealous which leads to a series of events that cause a fire.
On a wildlife sketching trip, Norman wants to find the most spectacular creature to sketch, but this gets a bit tricky when Lily Chen tags along.
When James and Sarah compete for the title of 'best steam driver,' James accidentally spills a burning coal into a pile of wood, sparking a fire.
When Charlie and Bronwyn take the kids on a sailing lesson, Charlie feels upstaged by Peter and a seagull. As Charlie tries to win back the kids' attention, he ends up sinking the boat.
A 'pesky' mole causes trouble for Moose when the mole decides that Moose's Wild Man Golf course is the perfect place to build a few molehills.
It's the Annual Pontypandy Bread Baking Competition and Hannah's ambition accidentally causes her to spark a wildfire.
Mandy and Sarah try to get the big scoop on who the special guest performing at the Big Pontypandy Festival will be!
Professor Pickles attempts to create an EPIC historical walking trail, but he creates emergency of EPIC proportions instead!
When Hannah turns the Pontypandy Ocean Parade into a race, an ocean rescue is required.
When James, Mandy and Annie use the horse and cart to deliver their cherry pop to The Taste of Pontypandy competition, chaos ensues!
Magic Mandini and The Great Normanski
Norman practices his magic act for the talent show, but his assistant Mandy is better at magic than he is.
It's time for the Big Pontypandy Talent Show! But when Elvis knocks a drink over the drone control panel, the drones crash land, causing many fires.
